items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Where is Macy’s Lisa? On O’Farrell near Powell?

ctx.x: It was the a place, The Savoy down where Macy’s is now. Where is the Macy’s on Market? Where is Macy’s Lisa? On O’Farrell near Powell? It’s a big store down there.
Everybody knows, it’s the Macy’s in San Francisco.
